[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for decluttering a closet, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Take everything out of the closet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sort items into categories (e.g., tops, bottoms, dresses, outerwear).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. If it hasn't been worn in a year, consider letting it go.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Ask yourself questions about each item (fit, condition, confidence, relevance, replaceability).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Keep items that spark joy, as per Marie Kondo's method.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Use the 3-box method: keep, donate/sell, discard.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Store out-of-season items out of sight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Organize what you're keeping with dividers, bins, and hooks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Use a "maybe" box with a deadline for uncertain items.
